analysis: repository-level placement of exact CLAUDE.md files

definitions.directory_depth: number of POSIX path components before the basename
definitions.high_containment: different content hashes, required shared-line minimum, below the Jaccard threshold, and intersection/minimum-set-size at or above the containment threshold
definitions.high_jaccard: different content hashes, required shared-line minimum, and normalized-line-set Jaccard similarity at or above the threshold
definitions.instruction_scope_chain: number of distinct CLAUDE.md-containing directory scopes along the nearest-ancestor chain, including the current scope
definitions.logical_scope: D for either D/CLAUDE.md or D/.claude/CLAUDE.md; an operational mapping from documented locations, not an observed load
definitions.nearest_ancestor: closest strict ancestor directory that also contains an exact CLAUDE.md; all files at an ambiguous nearest scope produce edges
definitions.normalized_equivalent: different content hashes but identical non-empty normalized-line sets
definitions.normalized_line: non-empty line after Unicode NFKC normalization, trimming, internal-whitespace collapse, and case folding; duplicates form a set
definitions.physical_nested_file: stored path has at least one '/' directory separator; this is a path property and not necessarily a non-root instruction scope
definitions.placement_form: direct D/CLAUDE.md or case-insensitive hidden D/.claude/CLAUDE.md candidate form; exact-case counts retained
definitions.root_file: stored path has no '/' directory separator

documented_scope_mapping.status: documented-location normalization of stored paths; not an observed Claude Code session or runtime load graph

scope_definition: case-insensitive basename equal to CLAUDE.md; stored GitHub paths use POSIX '/' separators

within_repository_normalized_line_overla.interpretation: exploratory lexical-overlap indicators; not validated semantic classifications of duplication, inheritance, or override behavior
